_about: The original's CameraController as the player moves it with a finger, and 1-21's lesson in it:
decoded from android_game.bin through Enhanced's asbc listing (out/parity/asbc/all_functions.txt,
md5 48fe65ce8baea16b94ed84d8d7be84b0; its reading rules are visuals/briefs/00_order.md 8.0, arguments
pushed last-first), and the engine's input (reference/ethanon). Step 138 of
docs/planning/2026-09-11-magic-portals-remaster.md. The follow itself - how fast the view eases to
the player - is still data/portals.json's camera.follow_lag_s, a _guess the port has always had: the
original's is Follower(1000, 100) (the ctor below, #66-82), which this step does not build.
No footage of the original shows a finger dragged across a level (out/parity/footage/INDEX.md: every
clip taps with `input swipe` held still at one point), so every number below is the decode's alone.

_drag_pan_enabled: true is THE ORIGINAL, as the owner's 2026-09-29 rulings decide every open call: the finger pans
the camera at twice its move, a drag away from the player holds the view hold_ms before the
follow takes it back, and the follow waits while a touch is held off the walk pads.
false RESTORES THE OWNER'S RULING OF 2026-09-11 (planning doc, 'What the owner settled'): 'the
camera follows the player, with no dragging'. Then none of the three happens, and the camera is
exactly the one the port had before step 138 - Camera::Follow's clamp-and-ease every tick.
_source: WHICH LEVELS: Game::preLoop (112536..114414) #95-146 builds AutoCameraController when the level's
`autoCamera` property is not '' and CameraController otherwise. level31a (2-32) is the one level of
128 that sets auto_camera (to dragon.ent): its camera is locked to the dragon, has no dragMoveCamera
and cannot be dragged. The other 127 levels drag. The controller is added right after the character
(#184-202), and PortalManager - which runs TouchInputManager::update - after it (#265-270): each
frame the pad is read, then the camera, then the touch manager.
CameraController::CameraController (105826..106336): #57-64 virtualCameraPos = GetCameraPos();
#66-82 follower = Follower(virtualCameraPos, 1000, 100); #84-86 cameraHoldTime = 4000 (hold_ms);
#88-91 cameraHoldElapsedTime = cameraHoldTime - SO THE HOLD STARTS SPENT, and there is NO opening
hold; #93-99 dragLockValue = scale(10) (drag_lock_units); #101-114 arrows = GetEntityArray('arrows.ent').
CameraController::update (107461..107866), every frame: #3-10 cameraHoldElapsedTime +=
getLastFrameElapsedTime(); #12-13 dragMoveCamera(); #24-38 the follow runs only when
cameraHoldElapsedTime > cameraHoldTime (CMPu, JP: strictly past) AND NOT hasAnyTouch(); #40-75
then follower.setDestinationPos(charPos - screen / 2), update, virtualCameraPos = its point;
#77-83 SetCameraPos(virtualCameraPos); #85-92 ScreenPad::isMoving() -> unlockCamera()
(cameraHoldElapsedTime = cameraHoldTime), AFTER this frame's follow; #94-95 clampCameraPos().
hasAnyTouch (108003..108274): some touch with GetTouchState == 2 (GSKS_DOWN, KeyStateManager.h:32:
held, and not its first frame) whose GetTouchPos is on no walk pad (ScreenPad::getTargetButton
== 0; 149699..149925: 240 on the left pad's circle, 255 on the right's, 0 elsewhere).
PortalManager::teleportToOther (144944..145873) #211-217 also calls unlockCamera for anything it
sends through a portal.
CameraController::dragMoveCamera (108505..109260), for every touch t: #3-7 nothing while
shouldLockCamera() (an arrows.ent handle being moved: Camera::Feel locked, handle.json, step 139);
#17-36 only where GetTouchMove(t) != (0, 0); #38-39 clampVirtualCamPos(); #41-63 the pan when
GetTouchPos(t) is on no pad AND length(move) < 100 (CMPIf 100f, TS: strictly less, a BARE screen-px
literal, max_frame_move_screen_px); #66-80 setVirtualCameraPos(virtualCameraPos - move x 2)
(pan_factor; setVirtualCameraPos also resets the follower there, 107910..108003); #82-92 then, only
when g_touchManager.getMaxMoveLength(t) > scale(24) (CMPf, JNP: strictly more; release_move_units),
#94-137 product = dp2(normalize(GetCameraPos() + screen / 2 - charPos), move): how fast the finger
moves along the line from the player to the view's centre, which pans the view back TOWARD the
player; #139-152 product < dragLockValue -> cameraHoldElapsedTime = 0 (the hold starts again), else
cameraHoldElapsedTime = cameraHoldTime (let go). gs2d's normalize of (0, 0) is (0, 0).
THE ENGINE'S INPUT (reference/ethanon, toolkit/Source/src): gs2d MobileInput::Update
(gs2d/src/Input/MobileInput.cpp:99-120) sets touchMove = current - last on a GSKS_DOWN frame only,
keeps it (the last frame's, which is 0) on GSKS_HIT, and zeroes it on RELEASE and UP; ETHInput
GetTouchMove (engine/Util/ETHInput.cpp:140-143) divides by the engine's global scale, which is 1
(00_order 8.0 rule 5). So a touch that goes down and comes up on the next frame never moves the
camera, never holds it and never stops its follow: every one of the routes' taps is one.
UNITS: the view is 256 units tall and scale(n) is n units on any screen (00_order 8.0 rule 5), so
release_move_units and drag_lock_units are 24 and 10, and the pan is 2 x the finger's move in units.
The 100 is not scaled: the port takes it at R12's 720 px screen, 720 / 256 = 2.8125 px a unit, as
earthquake.json takes its bare pixel amounts - 35.56 units a frame. The frame is the port's tick.
getMaxMoveLength is TouchInputManager's (placement.json release): the farthest the touch has been
from where it went down, as the manager's LAST update left it, since the camera runs before it.
1-21 (level20) is the one level that places hand_waypoint1 (at (99, 369), turned -0.6981) and
up_down_arrow.ent (at (100, 394), static): the census of the 128 converted levels. level19a (2-20)
places hand_waypoint0, the handle's lesson (handle.json lesson, step 139).
ETHCallback_hand_waypoint1 (ETHCallback_hand_waypoint.angelscript, 368220..369697). FIRST CALL
(no 'originalPos' yet, #1-12): #14-27 originalPos = its position; #29-32 WaypointManager(repeat
true: SetV1 v3, v1 is the constant 1, 00_order 8.0 rule 1); four addWaypoint calls, each
Waypoint(pos = scale(vector2(x, y)), time, FloatColor(-1), filter, angle 0) with vector2's x pushed
2600 ms, smoothBeginning; #136-168 (10, 100), 300 ms, smoothEnd (hand_waypoints: a move to the
right, then down the arrow, then back, 3300 ms a round); #187-225 DrawFadingText(vector2(scale(50),
screenH - scale(0.8) x 40), 'move the camera around', getMatura42FontName(), 0xFFFFFFFF, 10000 ms,
scale(0.8) / getHdSpriteDensity()) - text, left_units 50 and above_bottom_units 0.8 x 40 = 32 on
the screen, not the level; fade_ms; getMatura42FontName (398909..399050) is Matura84_shadow.fnt on
an hd screen, the caption's own font, and its scale 0.8 of the caption's g_scale.getScale() /
getHdSpriteDensity() (ui.json caption: 0.5 units a font pixel), so units_per_font_px 0.4;
#231-242 lifeTime = 0. EVERY CALL, the first included: #245-259 lifeTime +=
getLastFrameElapsedTime(); #273-285 lifeTime > 20000 (CMPIu, JNP) -> DeleteEntity (life_ms);
#309-310 manager.update(); #325-352 SetPositionXY(originalPos + current.pos); #354-378
SetAlpha(clamp(current.color.a x (1 - lifeTime / 20000) x 2, 0, 1)) - every waypoint's colour is
FloatColor(-1), alpha 1, so hand_alpha_gain 2: whole for 10 s, gone by 20 s.
WaypointManager (ETHFramework/WaypointManager.angelscript 40760..42634) and FrameTimer::set
(23254..23650): each update adds the frame's time; the first after the waypoints are added starts
again at waypoint 0 with no time; once the time reaches the waypoint's own time the frame steps ONE
on with the rest kept, and past the last a REPEATING manager goes back to the first (#64-68);
getCurrentPoint (41513..42094) mixes this waypoint into the next - the first after the last, when
repeating - by THIS waypoint's filter of min(time, stride) / max(stride, 1).
ETHCallback_up_down_arrow (369697..370197): #1-25 lifeTime = 0 on the first call; #27-41 lifeTime +=
getLastFrameElapsedTime(); #55-67 past 20000 -> DeleteEntity; #69-88 SetAlpha(clamp((1 - lifeTime /
20000) x 0.3 x 2, 0, 1)) (arrow_alpha, arrow_alpha_gain: 0.6 at first, 0 at 20 s); #90-108
bounce(this, vector2(1.1, 1), vector2(1, 1.1), 300) (bounce, utilEntityEffect.angelscript
327057..327527: its own clock from 0 on the same frames, so the same as lifeTime; a leg a stride, odd
legs backwards, eased by smoothEnd - Art::Pulse; SetScale(g_scale.scale(scale)), so the picture at
that scale of its own size).
LIBRARY STILLS (out/parity/original/levels/1-21_h0.3, _h2.8, _h6.3, _t8.0): the text along the
screen's bottom, fading; the hand beside the arrow, a little right of its placed point and lower
by a varying amount; the arrow faint. Step 138 measures them.
